decisions.reason: It fits the firm’s core airport-operations platform, has remained prominently marketed across two years, and in a growing firm the option value of keeping a strategically central software product open is high while withdrawal appears unnecessary.

Its move from a website mention to a dedicated page suggests enough positive learning and commercial traction to justify continued support, especially because it extends the firm’s integrated apron digital offering at limited incremental risk.

Although somewhat more peripheral than core operational control products, it was upgraded to a standalone offer in 2024, so management would likely keep the option alive for another year while demand uncertainty resolves.

Equipment monitoring closely leverages the firm’s installed-base knowledge, service capability, and automation direction, so the product still offers attractive option value and little reason for immediate abandonment.
